# TruffleHog path exclusions (regex, one per line).
# Scoped allowlist for documented placeholder credentials in starter examples.
# The pre-push hook only fails on --results=verified, so unverified
# placeholders no longer block pushes on their own; these example/placeholder
# files are also excluded to keep scan output clean. They ship illustrative
# connection-string placeholders that are not real secrets.
.*\.env\.example$
apps/starter-[^/]+/README\.md$
